ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Qualified and later stages need Lead partner and Scope summary.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Lead_partner__c), ISBLANK(Scope_summary__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Lead partner and Scope summary before moving to Qualified.
